messages:
maria: quick check: prod report of spiky uploads leading to occasional "soft" signals. do we have a clear contract for clients re: when to back off vs when to expect a hard 429? need guidance for SDKs + docs.

sam: TL;DR: two signals. hard throttle = 429 + Retry-After (seconds). soft signal = 200 OK with warning headers + optional in-body hint. soft = advisory, not an error. SDKs should surface an object instead of forcing apps to parse headers.

jordan: specifics on headers we emit for soft vs hard (runtime currently):
- Soft: `X-RW-Quota-Warn: soft; wait_ms=150` and `X-RW-Quota-Remaining: 3`
- Hard: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` + `Retry-After: 4` and `X-RW-Quota-Bucket: route-uploads-42`

ashley: sample soft response we return today (client-visible):

````
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-RW-Quota-Warn: soft; wait_ms=150
X-RW-Quota-Remaining: 3

{ "result": { /* normal payload */ }, "warnings": [{"id":"soft_quota","wait_ms":150, "msg":"inside burst smoothing window"}] }
````

maria: thanks. proposal: SDK field name `throttleAdvice` with shape consistent across languages. idea: null | { mode: "soft"|"hard", waitMs?: "number as int string?" no, prefer int, remaining?: int }. preference: use integers for waitMs.

sam: agree. for hard use Retry-After first if present; convert to ms in SDK for consistency. note: runtime sends Retry-After in seconds (int) — we will not send HTTP-date. doc that.

rate-limiter-bot: [EVENT] hard-throttle example:

````
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 3
X-RW-Quota-Policy: route:upload
X-RW-Quota-Bucket: route-upload-123
{ "error": "rate_limit_exceeded", "detail": "per-route burst exhausted" }
````

jordan: compatibility note: some clients parse remaining counters as "0/10" strings. runtime will provide plain ints in `X-RW-Quota-Remaining`, but older proxies might still emit slash format. SDK should try integer parse first, fallback to split.

ashley: rollout note: when we change burst window sizes during deploy, we may emit more soft warnings for a short time. docs should call out that soft warnings are not guaranteed to precede a 429; they may appear alone. also include guidance: exponential jittered backoff vs immediate retry.

maria: action items: I'll update API contract doc with header examples and the SDK `throttleAdvice` schema. can someone add a unit test in runtime to assert sequence: succeed -> soft warnings -> hard 429 after sustained exceed?

jordan: I'll add tests. test plan: simulate 30 requests against route with burst=5, sustained rate -> assert first 5 ok, next 10 yield 200+soft-warning, subsequent requests after sustained exceed get 429s. will add assertions for header presence and bucket label.

sam: also want telemetry event for signals: `throttle.signal` with labels {mode, route, bucket, wait_ms}. this helps analytics for tuning burst windows. devex, please map telemetry to SDK breadcrumbs.

devex-bot: created GH issue #6057 "SDK: surface throttleAdvice + header parsing + telemetry mapping" (assignee: maria)

maria: cool. tagging @sam @jordan for PR reviews. once we merge SDK changes, update quickstart snippet showing `client.throttleAdvice` usage.

sam: ack, will review. :white_check_mark:

jordan: ack, will open tests PR today. :clock1:
